text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Ow, ow, ow, ow...!
That hurts like absolute hell, I say~~!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Still...
I must get back to practice right away...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That is it! At times like this, you just have to power through with a combination of painkillers and taping!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If we treat it properly,
I'm sure it'll be just fine, yes...!
choice_data_list: You have to take a rest.
If you push yourself even a little, I'm stopping you.
If you push yourself even a bit, I'll stop you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If we treat it properly,
I'm sure it'll be just fine, yes...!
choice_data_list: You have to take a rest.
If you push yourself even a little, I'm stopping you.
If you push yourself even a bit, I'll stop you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No...
If we can just manage the pain, I can still run...!
choice_data_list: Suppressing the pain doesn't mean it's healed.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, indeed... If that made it worse,
it would defeat the whole purpose...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah~...
Sitting still just isn't in my nature~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
I promise you I will never overdo it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us begin at once.
Let's see, the tape is in the medicine cabinet, correct?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gyahin!!
Ouuuuch~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess fell and worsened her injury. Naturally, I instructed her to rest.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer,
could you grab the tape from the medicine cabinet?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah~! Princess Taping!
Pain, pain, fly away graciously~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew!
Strength training is no trouble at all for me~!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thank you so much.
For believing in me and giving me permission to practice.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer... When I'm like this, I feel as though I can overcome anything.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: If it's with you, surely...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...And so! Practice resumes!
Don't overdo it, keep it sensible! But go all out!
Let's smash through some muscle training~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, by keeping to a reasonable training routine,
Kawakami Princess brilliantly overcame her injury!
